scope: Original whole-frame native FP32 stored outputs and training-source GT masks; no new inference. Sequence1 has 1 GT on every frame, Sequence17 none. The distance series measures the closest above-threshold archived peak anywhere on each full native frame. Distances are left empty for Sequence17 because it has no GT.
curves_semantics: Shading frames 81–87 marks seven-frame detail; the red dashed line is 3-px criterion. Thumbnails are native Sequence1 images, full gray scale 0..255 with a 15x15-pixel rectangle centered at GT centroid to point out its location. False alarms are counts across the whole original frame, not counts of pixels.
